title: Bajjar Singh Breaks the Kebloor Fort

blocks.text: The attack succeeds with startling speed: elephants are struck down, fortifications give way, and Bajjar Singh and the others force entry where the defenders thought themselves secure.
Once inside, the Khalsa routs the enemy, buries or disposes of the dead, and immediately turns victory into controlled occupation rather than chaos.
Bajjar Singh stands out here as a key breaker of the defenses and a sign that the hill fort could not resist the Khalsa assault.
